dimensions.name: Contract Validity
dimensions.reason: Message output must satisfy the Phase 2C schema and validation contract.

dimensions.name: Headline Quality
dimensions.reason: Headline should state a conclusion or decision implication within 60 characters.

dimensions.name: Message Clarity
dimensions.reason: Main message, supporting points, and takeaway should each have distinct roles.

dimensions.name: One-slide-one-message
dimensions.reason: A slide should retain one core message and no more than three support points.

dimensions.name: Evidence Alignment
dimensions.reason: Message strength should match available Evidence Planner requirements.

dimensions.name: Numeric Integrity Readiness
dimensions.reason: Numeric, ROI, ratio, currency, and period claims require traceable basis evidence.

dimensions.name: Narrative Consistency
dimensions.reason: Message should respect Deck Blueprint slide role, slide goal, and narrative function.

dimensions.name: Audience Fit
dimensions.reason: Style and detail level should match audience seniority and decision stage.

dimensions.name: Decision Relevance
dimensions.reason: Customer-facing proposal messages should help the next decision.

dimensions.name: Customer-facing Readability
dimensions.reason: Messages should avoid placeholders, internal labels, and vague language.

dimensions.name: Executive Readiness
dimensions.reason: Executive-ready messages separate conclusion, evidence, risk, and next action.

dimensions.name: Sales Persuasiveness
dimensions.reason: Message should be useful for a sales conversation while remaining evidence-safe.

evaluation_result.note: This score evaluates message design readiness only. It does not evaluate Slide Blueprints, diagrams, layouts, theme tokens, typography, PPTX rendering, Beautiful.ai output, or final sales outcome.
